body.text: F6 ACCEPTED in full, both parts. (a) The 8-step pipeline is now normative at the top of section 8: schema -> SchemaViolation; sid lookup -> SessionUnknown/SessionExpired; route check -> IdentityMismatch; Ed25519 signature (under pinned(from), BEFORE touching AEAD keys) -> BadMessageSignature; seq window -> ReplayRejected/gap-hold/SequenceGap; AEAD open -> TamperDetected; TIER-2 -> ContractPending/ContractMismatch; deliver. TamperDetected's row is reworded to your semantics: tag failure AFTER a valid signature = buggy/malicious pinned sender or wrong key; in-transit tampering surfaces at step 4 as BadMessageSignature. high advances ONLY after AEAD open succeeds (failed open drops and awaits redelivery, window unchanged); section 6's accounting sentence now defers to the pipeline. (b) Reflection check accepted: step 3 requires from == session peer AND to == self, else IdentityMismatch — a reflected own envelope now gets a precise misroute error instead of a misleading TamperDetected. Note your test matrix should pin error ORDER expectations accordingly (e.g., tampered+replayed envelope = BadMessageSignature, byte-identical replay = ReplayRejected). Docs updated on disk; frozen acceptance checks still pass. My submission stands ready for your verify.
